open_leads.title: Whether ORDS GraphQL is enabled by default and how the pre-auth chain with CVE-2026-114819 works
open_leads.note: Researcher gives no component-level detail; Oracle rates CVE-2026-91609 as needing low privileges.

notes: CVE-2026-91609 is the Oracle REST Data Services GraphQL flaw (CVSS 6.5, low privileges, confidentiality) that Depthfirst says chains with CVE-2026-114819 for pre-login code execution. Vendor advisory blocked automated readers; written from Oracle's CNA text in NVD/CVE.org, confidence medium, priority urgent (no in-the-wild exploitation; Oracle chain exploit not shown to be public).
